description: A person reborn into another world after a past life. The official synopsis says Cid dreams of lying low as a minor character until he can reveal himself as a mastermind—or pretending to be one—and makes conditions to act out that ambition. He jokingly recruits people to an organization and invents an evil-cult backstory, unaware that the imagined adversaries are real.
